subject: reasoning
question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Same difference of the position values between first letter and second letter and second letter and third letter according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• OQS​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/148bbd7c21b582fa45f7fe0fa3ba8b34e5353bc45e8043b01e63ca9345f2045b.png] ​

 
• JLN​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85c1f0bd5ec1bf92e07affab3ede645ddcfc245a6227658331a6228fbf8f48ca.png] 

 
• HJL​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d76cc0fe7a95d3d69417ccdb60434b3fb861596e83ab950ad4a70490efb47346.png] 

 
• MOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e545bd7e705dd475c47d6a9e8917aa94b4ab181fa40626fd314aa707d3ec65cc.png] 

Here, Only 'MOP' is the odd one out as the difference is not same between the 1st letter and 2nd letter and 2nd letter and 3rd letter.

Hence, "MOP" is the correct answer.

7d:Tf2
